title: Verified Fellas postseason records
rules: Playoff appearances, semifinals, finals, first-round byes and No. 1 seeds use verified championship bracket records only; consolation and third-place games do not create playoff berths or finals.

Postseason single-week matchup scoring records include all archived playoff and consolation matchups where period scoring is a single NFL week, including Sleeper games whose bracket classification is unavailable.

2016–2017 ESPN two-week aggregates and 2019 cumulative consolation scoring are excluded from all single-week scoring records. Older ESPN seasons used different scoring and rounding, so cross-era raw-point comparisons are descriptive only.
Postseason scoring results are not championship-bracket win–loss records; no source-backed Sleeper win–loss playoff classification is inferred from an unclassified matchup.
